hinge.title: Rotation is Earth turning on its own axis, while revolution is Earth moving around the Sun; the yearly change in the night sky comes from revolution.

mx.teacher_note: The entire difference between January's 8 p.m. sky and February's 2 a.m. sky is caused by Earth's revolution.

intelligence.enrichment: Rotation is motion around an object's own axis, while revolution is motion around another object; Earth's revolution around the Sun changes the stars seen at a fixed time of night over months. Earth's changing position in its orbit around the Sun changes which part of space is visible in the night sky at the same time of night. The learner correctly applies this rule: Rotation is motion around an object's own axis, while revolution is motion around another object; Earth's revolution around the Sun changes the stars seen at a fixed time of night over months. Rotation and revolution are two names for the same Earth motion.
